name: claude-code-mods
description: The Claude Code mods Yusif Darwish runs every day, in one marketplace. Each entry installs from its original author's repository, pinned to a tested commit.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Redraws the transcript: tool calls with icons and timings, edits as diff cards, tables and code as cards, a phase spinner, and context and plan-limit rings above the prompt. /skin swaps between seven skins live.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: A progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, estimated cost and time.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree pane: git status and lines changed per file, and a shimmer on the files Claude reads (purple), writes (orange) and commits (green).

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Shapes Claude's replies for an ADHD reader: next action first, numbered steps, no tangents, no preamble or closers. Type /i-have-adhd to turn it on.
